methods.name: propose_house
methods.desc: Step 1 (current house): name the next house. Nothing changes until it accepts.

methods.name: accept_house
methods.desc: Step 2 (the proposed account itself): take over as house.

methods.name: close_now
methods.desc:
House or an active judge stops betting immediately (e.g. the fight starts early).
close_ts can only move EARLIER; resolve_by_ts is unchanged.

methods.name: withdraw_fee
methods.desc:
Anyone: send a resolved pool's 10% fee (once) to its fee_receiver, or to the house if the
receiver is not opted in to USDC. A frozen receiver can only block its own fee.
